تحتقبين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِبِينَ (taḥtaqibīna) /taħ.ta.qi.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# تُحْتَقَبِينَ (tuḥtaqabīna) /tuħ.ta.qa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
